kind: reference constants (published table), not field data

source.name: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 19: Typical soil water characteristics for different soil types (USDA soil texture classification)

available_water.note: Ranges as printed in the table. Farmily uses the midpoint of the (FC - WP) range and always shows the range. The table has no row for sandy clay loam, clay loam or sandy clay, so no value is used for those classes.
available_water.row_name_note: Table 19 prints 'Silt clay loam' for the class Farmily's classifier calls 'Silty Clay Loam'.
